name: convert_file
description: Convert media files locally, or remove a solid background from an existing image without regenerating its subject. Examples: "make this image background transparent", "remove the white background from my uploaded image", "convert my image to PNG", "convert video to MP3". Background removal uses options.remove_background=true and target_format png/webp; removes only edge-connected color and keeps enclosed matching colors. Best for plain backgrounds, not scenery or fine-hair matting. Supports image formats (jpg/png/webp/gif/tiff/bmp), raster-to-SVG tracing, video/audio conversion and video-to-audio extraction. Accepts stash:// references or local files; outputs save to Stash for inline preview and download.

source.description: Source file: stash://space_id/file_id reference OR local file path

target_format.description: Target format extension without dot: png, jpg, webp, gif, svg, mp4, webm, mp3, wav, flac, ogg, aac

options.description: Optional conversion settings. Image: quality (1-100), resize ('800x600' or '50%'), strip_metadata (bool). Video: crf (quality 0-51), resolution ('1920x1080'), fps, duration (seconds). Audio: bitrate ('192k'), sample_rate (44100), channels (1 or 2). SVG: threshold ('50%' for tracing) Solid-background removal: remove_background (bool), background_color (auto or #RRGGBB), background_tolerance (0-25 percent, default 5). Requires PNG/WebP output and a single-frame raster input. Changing JPEG to PNG alone does not remove a background.

remove_background.description: Remove a solid edge-connected background while preserving enclosed matching colors. Default false. Use target_format png or webp. Not semantic subject segmentation.

background_color.description: With remove_background: auto (default) checks corner colors; or explicit #RRGGBB such as #FFFFFF.

background_tolerance.description: With remove_background: color tolerance percentage, default 5. Lower retains more detail; higher removes more similar edge-connected colors. Do not use high tolerance on white subjects.
